shortDescription: NetApp Element Software create/modify/rename/delete QOS Policy

options.name: debug
options.description: report additional information when set to true.

options.name: from_name
options.description: Name or id for the QOS policy to be renamed.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the SolidFire cluster. For na_elementsw_cluster, the Management IP (MIP) or hostname of the node to initiate the cluster creation from.

options.name: name
options.description: Name or id for the QOS policy.

options.name: qos
options.description: The quality of service (QQOS) for the policy. Required for create Supported keys are minIOPS, maxIOPS, burstIOPS

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified QOS policy should exist or not.

options.name: username
options.description: Please ensure that the user has the adequate permissions. For more information, please read the official documentation U(https://mysupport.netapp.com/documentation/docweb/index.html?productID=62636&language=en-US).
